scope: Theorem 3.55 (The restricted package in every dimension) of the manuscript “Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Log-abundance-for-compact-Kahler-spaces-under-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 77-78. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: The assertions Bd, Cd, Md and Fd hold in every finite dimension, for the globally nef carrier data and globally modified-big 77 boundary traces specified above. All birational steps used to prove them are detected steps or belong to an already-projective relative construction with the stated relative-line algebraicity. A general semiample morphism is asserted to be Moishezon; projectivity is asserted only when the construction provides an actual relatively ample line.
